name: Tax Efficient Product 7
definition: Characteristics of a tax efficient product.

TaxEfficientProductType.name: Tax Efficient Product Type
TaxEfficientProductType.definition: Type of tax efficient product, for example, an individual savings account (ISA) in the UK.

CurrentYear.name: Current Year
CurrentYear.definition: Indicates that all the current fiscal year’s products are included.

CashComponentIndicator.name: Cash Component Indicator
CashComponentIndicator.definition: Indicates whether, for the current year, the product contains a cash asset for transfer.

PreviousYears.name: Previous Years
PreviousYears.definition: Investment plans issued during previous years.

PreviousYearSubscriptionAmount.name: Previous Year Subscription Amount
PreviousYearSubscriptionAmount.definition: Subscriptions from the previous subscription year.

PreviousYearsSubscriptionAmount.name: Previous Years Subscription Amount
PreviousYearsSubscriptionAmount.definition: Amount subscribed in all previous years.

CurrentYearSubscriptionDetails.name: Current Year Subscription Details
CurrentYearSubscriptionDetails.definition: Amounts already subscribed for the current year.

WithdrawalForResidentialPurchaseProgress.name: Withdrawal For Residential Purchase Progress
WithdrawalForResidentialPurchaseProgress.definition: Indicates if there is a related property purchase in progress at the point of transfer. May be applicable to products such as Lifetime Individual Savings Account (LISA) products.

TransferorAlternateIdentification.name: Transferor Alternate Identification
TransferorAlternateIdentification.definition: Alternative identification for the transferor (ceding party), for example, the 'ISA manager Z reference' in the UK.

TotalSubscriptionAmount.name: Total Subscription Amount
TotalSubscriptionAmount.definition: Total amount subscribed over the lifetime of the product.

OtherAmount.name: Other Amount
OtherAmount.definition: Another amount such as the total qualifying additions in the year of transfer, interest capitalised in the current year, total outstanding dividend and so on.

DateFirstQualifyingAddition.name: Date First Qualifying Addition
DateFirstQualifyingAddition.definition: Date the first qualifying additional amount was made to the product.  Qualifying additional amounts may be made to a Lifetime Individual Savings Account (LISA) product.

InvestorTaxReference.name: Investor Tax Reference
InvestorTaxReference.definition: Identification of the investor as assigned by a tax authority.

InvestmentsToFollowValue.name: Investments To Follow Value
InvestmentsToFollowValue.definition: Value of the investments to follow.

InnovativeFinance.name: Innovative Finance
InnovativeFinance.definition: Information about an innovative finance product.

LowestInvestedAmountCurrentYear.name: Lowest Invested Amount Current Year
LowestInvestedAmountCurrentYear.definition: Lowest investment amount in the current year, used to calculate a tax deduction amount.

TaxCalculationBase.name: Tax Calculation Base
TaxCalculationBase.definition: Amount of money from which the tax deduction is calculated.

EstimatedValue.name: Estimated Value
EstimatedValue.definition: Estimated value of the assets of the tax efficient product to be transferred.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional information about the tax efficient product.
